effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 2 of 5 is on now: Team A (Itsuka Kendo and Kinoko Komori) as heroes against Team B (Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu and Ibara Shiozaki) as villains. Only Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu and Ibara Shiozaki are villains; nobody else joins them. Already fought, never again: Teams E, F. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team C (Neito Monoma and Sen Kaibara) against Team D (Yosetsu Awase and Kojiro Bondo); Teams E, F, A, B are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 3 more rounds remain. If the story sums up the rest of the trial in one turn, the remaining rounds are exactly: 3. Monoma/Kaibara vs Awase/Bondo; 4. Honenuki/Shishida vs Rin/Kodai; 5. Shoda/Tsuburaba vs Kuroiro/Fukidashi; Reiko Yanagi fights in none of them. Nobody else fights. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.
